name: Da Yi Cheng Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Da Yi Cheng Technology Co.,Ltd. provides power engineering construction and plant support services for high tech industry. The company offers front-end design, MEP project, precision wiring services for secondary power distribution engineering, system integration and construction, interconnection, and factory engineering services. It also engages in circuit engineering and other related businesses. Da Yi Cheng Technology Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2021 and is based in Tainan City, Taiwan.
